title: Hanasato Minori — Debrief Assistance〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: MORE MORE HOUSE

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: And now, Samo really loves those treats. He rubs up against me every morning to beg for them!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, I don't think I'd be able to resist giving some to him if he did that to me.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I know, right? I've actually been sorta worried lately since he seemed to lose all interest in treats. Turns out he just wanted something new.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Something new...
Yeah, I think I get how he feels.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I've been eating basically the same thing every day in order to become more fit.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: When you have specific nutrients you're looking for, there are only so many ingredients to choose from.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Exactly. I've been so focused on getting as much protein as I can while limiting my calorie intake...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, in that case, I recommend a gooey mapo tofu made using natto and okra.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Natto and tofu are great sources of protein, and okra's packed with all kinds of nutrients, so it's really good for you.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
And it sounds like a low-calorie dish.
Mapo tofu's easy enough to make, so I'll try whipping up a batch sometime.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Soba is also a very healthy option.
It's full of protein and vitamins, while also being low on carbohydrates. You can even vary what toppings you use so it doesn't get old.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, changing things up using a variety of toppings is a nice idea. I might look up some soba recipes later.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Wow... Everyone's so strict about their diets...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I've been trying to watch my calories and eat nutritious things...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (But yesterday...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Minori? You've been awfully quiet. Is something wrong?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Eep! N-Nothing's wrong!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I was just thinking how yummy all the things you just talked about probably are. Hahahaha...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You're acting really suspicious...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wh-What makes you say that...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Just spit it out already...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Urgh...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Umm... The thing is, yesterday...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Phew... Now that I've finished this math assignment...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Woohoo! I'm done with everything I had piled up!

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Oh, you're done? Congratulations.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thanks! Some of these assignments are due today, so I'm really glad I finished.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Haha. My tummy's rumbling...

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Hehe. Your brain did just get a good workout. Oh, wanna have one of these? I bought them when I went on that shoot the other day. I was gonna give you one later, but...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, dorayaki!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (No, wait...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I ate those snacks while doing my assignments just now. If I eat this, then I'll go way over my calorie budget for today...!)

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: Oh, are these not your thing...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: N-No, I love dorayaki!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I'll just make up for it by running more tomorrow!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thanks for offering! I'll take one!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
So, I couldn't resist...
And I ended up eating that dorayaki...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: O-Okay, but...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'm gonna make up for the mistake I made yesterday by going for a run! Right now!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Huh?! Minori, wait...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: There she goes.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It's not like I was gonna get mad at her over that.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I guess it was weighing on Minori's conscience just that much.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. We stand to learn a lot from her example.
